title: Squadron 42 delayed until 2027 and its developers blame GTA 6
summary: The long-awaited single-player game of Star Citizen postpones its launch again due to the attention garnered by Grand Theft Auto 6.

title: Developers report theft of computers at Gamescom 2026 and criticize organizer's response
summary: Several developers report equipment theft during the fair and the organization merely reminds that security is the responsibility of exhibitors.

title: The Long Dark to receive new DLC while its sequel Blackfrost takes a back seat
summary: Hinterland prioritizes the original's survival mode and releases additional content to ensure studio viability in an uncertain market.

title: Xbox describes Project Helix as a 'family of devices' for the next generation
summary: Microsoft confirms its next hardware will not be a single console, but avoids commenting on The Elder Scrolls VI exclusivity.

title: EA acknowledges leak of Iron Man game gameplay: 'It didn't go as planned'
summary: The company breaks silence after unauthorized footage spread and admits the incident was not part of its marketing strategy.

title: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 impresses in first impressions and aims to be the definitive game of the universe
summary: Journalists who have tried the title highlight its fidelity to the lore and its potential to become the strategic reference for Warhammer 40k.
